prompt: In a photorealistic photo, a golden wheat field stretches under a bright sky during the height of harvest. On the far left, an old farmer in a straw hat stands beside a rusty red tractor, his hand resting on the warm metal hood. Next to him, a young woman in denim overalls holds a sheaf of wheat, her eyes fixed on the horizon. A brown dog sits patiently by the tractor's large rear tire, watching the scene with alert ears. In the center foreground, a wooden crate overflows with ripe pumpkins, their orange skins contrasting with the dry stalks. A man in a blue flannel shirt kneels beside the crate, carefully selecting a gourd. Behind him, a child in a yellow raincoat points excitedly at a flock of crows circling above. To the right, a tall woman in a green apron hands a water bottle to a sweating worker in a gray tank top. The worker takes the bottle, wiping his brow with a dirty rag. Nearby, a white goat chews on a loose stalk of wheat, tethered loosely to a fence post. A black cat sleeps atop the fence post, ignoring the goat entirely. Further back, a pickup truck loaded with hay bales is parked near the barn. A boy in a baseball cap leans against the truck's tailgate, swinging his legs. An older woman in a floral dress stands next to the boy, shielding her eyes from the sun. A basket of apples rests on the ground near her feet. A rooster struts past the basket, its feathers gleaming. There is no modern machinery like combines visible in the frame. There is no snow or winter clothing present in the scene.
